posts.title: weird americanisms i don’t understand
posts.description: In light of today’s Midterm elections, I find it very apt to post this slightly snarky post. As someone who grew up on the Americanized internet, there were so many peculiarities about it that sometimes bordered on it being an alternate reality that I didn’t understand and still don’t to this day. posts.title: the terrorists we are
posts.description: People often talk about what radicalized them on podcasts and whatnot and ever since reading Pirate’s radicalization moment (in the left direction) a few months ago, I’ve been thinking about my own moment which I believe I’ve finally identified: It was the start of the current Palestinian genocide. My belief in the universalism of human rights (that they would apply to me) was shaken occasionally
